title: Reconcile an account
summary: How to check that your books agree with a Westpac statement, so you know nothing is missing.

steps.text: Click Bank in the sidebar, then Reconcile beside the account.
Check the statement date and the closing balance. They are filled in from the last file you imported; change them to match a paper or PDF statement if you like.

image.description: The Reconcile sheet for Business One with sample data. The statement date is 20/11/2026 and the closing balance $18,642.35. Statement, your books and the difference are listed, the difference is $0.00, and it says your books agree with the statement. Cancel and Finish are at the bottom.

steps.text: Read the difference. At $0.00 your books agree with the statement: click Finish. The Bank page then says the date it is reconciled to.

sections.heading: If there is a difference
paragraphs: Lines from the statement that are not posted yet are listed under it. Post them in To review, then reconcile again.
If nothing is listed, check the balance you typed, and look for a line missing from your books or posted to the wrong bank account.
Once reconciled, a line it covered cannot be undone from To review. Change its account in Transactions if you need to.
